evidence: The MoS2 film were deposited using a showerhead-type ALD (ALD) reactor (Lucida-M100, NCD Technology) with Mo(CO)6 and H2S plasma as the precursor and reactant, respectively. The Mo precursor was vaporized in a bubbler at 40 °C and carried to the chamber by Ar gas at 50 standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm).
